column1: # World batch: owner <TAB> M <TAB> old <TAB> descriptor <TAB> semantic name
# Getter/setter pairs follow the field they touch (a=MapDefinition, b/c=name/description, d=random,
# g=GameMode, h=speed factor from UserConfig.getWorldSpeedFactor(), i=TerrainGrid, j=players,
# k=units, l=birds, m=wind). Field e (float) is the game clock (birds use it for heading, CTF for
# its timer, WorldSerializer writes it) and field f (int) is the turn (WorldSimulator does i()+1).
# n is a reusable scratch list: WorldSimulator clears it inside the collision hot loop.
